title: EventSuccessLayoutViewDocument
description: Server-maintained read view of one event's room layout, at eventSuccessLayoutViews/{eventId}: exactly what getEventSuccessSpatialLayout returns, the selected organizer layout's id, label and units, or a null layout when the plan selects none or seats the whole group. Written by triggers on eventSuccessPlans and organizerEventSuccessLayouts. Room geometry only: never a guest, an assignment, a seat or another organizer's layout, and never identity, permission or mutation authority. Readable by the event's organizer managers and by a guest whose own booking is signed up or attended, or whose own runtime participant row is ready, exactly as the callable admitted them.
